chapter: The Meadow (meadow) - regenerated on the desert's ember model (#904): a mid-register trombone tune the ear can follow over offbeat guitar skanks and a walking bass, a first section that lifts into a fuller second one, the sunshine carried by warm horns and a steady beat rather than by shrill, toy-like highs

chosen.owner_ruling: The owner, 2026-10-18 (translated from Czech): "Sunny new, Ska not yet; the candidate c3 for Ska is better than the original." He answered on the listening page of 2026-10-17, where c3 and the shipped #486 recording could both be played. That ruling overrides the short-gap gate for this one recording: it reads 29.3 short gaps a minute where ember's highest is 27.0 (the replaced recording: 99.2), and it is the only column outside ember's range.
chosen.why: Measured on the baked recording beside the ember family in one run (Tools/Generation/measure-music.py --reference ember --sidecars Research/AI-Music), against the replaced recording: 29.3 short gaps a minute (replaced 99.2; ember 0.0-27.0, the one column outside the line, the deepest gap 36 dB and the longest 160 ms against 42 dB and 150 ms); 0 clipped runs (replaced 21; the master reads 543, none once baked); 14.8 % in 300 Hz-4 kHz (replaced 11.6 %) and 0.7 % above 6 kHz (replaced 1.7 %); tonal mid 75 % (66 %), 2.82 held-note changes a second (3.07; ember at least 2.74), tempo wander 0.13 % (0.04 %), pitch wobble 2.9 and detune 2.7 cents (3.4 and 2.7); 0.0 % of 140 held notes out of C major; the opening repeats 1 bar and the longest repeat is 1 bar. The loop is 45.0 s (23.98 bars at 127.9 bpm), the cut's context match 0.960, rhythm r 0.92 against 0.65 a bar later, spectrum cosine 0.95; the level swings 4 dB and no 2 s stretch is a hole. It needed no trim: the master's own peak is +2.15 dBFS (543 clipped runs), the themes' loudness takes 2.2 dB off, 0.001 % of the samples pass the knee and the post-codec peak is -0.25 dBFS. Eight renders over three briefs (below) read 26.7-101.3 short gaps a minute, and the one inside the line lost its tune figures, so c3 is the nearest on every column. Judged by numbers and by the owner's ear: the tune and the warmth are his.
chosen.how: every candidate measured on its master with measure-music.py (ember loops in the same run) beside the loop cut's own check; the baked recording measured again from its .ogg; the table is in the closing comment of #904
